import sys,json
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from crosscheck import CrossCheck
T={'nodes':[{'id':0,'name':'A','external_capacity':100},{'id':1,'name':'B','external_capacity':100}],'links':[{'source':0,'target':1,'capacity':100}],'external_nodes':['A','B']}
S={'trials':2,'epsilon':0,'seed':7,'cutoff':[0,1],'bias':0,'tau':0,'gamma':[1,1],'cache_slots':3}

 pA=[{'path':['A','B'],'weight':1000}] if not split else [{'path':['A','B'],'weight':400},{'path':['A','B'],'weight':600}]
 pB=[{'path':['B','A'],'weight':1000}] if not split else [{'path':['B','A'],'weight':400},{'path':['B','A'],'weight':600}]
 return {'A':{'B':pA},'B':{'A':pB}}
ev=[
 {'op':'patch','demands':[[0,1,10]],'counters':{'low_A_origination':{'perturbed':10},'low_B_termination':{'perturbed':10}}},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r1'},
 {'op':'routes','label':'a','paths':routes()},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r2'},
 {'op':'patch','demands':[[0,1,10]],'counters':{'low_A_origination':{'perturbed':10,'ground_truth':999,'corrected':0}}},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r3'},
 {'op':'routes','label':'b','paths':routes(split=True)},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r4'},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r5'},
 {'op':'routes','label':'c','paths':routes()},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r6'},
 {'op':'patch','demands':[],'counters':{'low_A_origination':{'perturbed':11}}},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r7'},
 {'op':'patch','demands':[],'counters':{'low_A_origination':{'perturbed':10}}},
 {'op':'repair','id':'r8'},
 {'op':'validate','id':'r1'},
]
for i,a in enumerate(CrossCheck(T).replay(ev,S)):
 if a['op']=='repair':print(i,a['id'],a['cache_hit'])
 else:print(i,a['op'],a.get('accepted'),a.get('checked'))
